song.name: After the Snowfall
song.plot: Anya and Seraphina meet in the frozen wastes and recognize a shared nature — two souls of Light-and-Void who are not what the dark expects. The first thread of the bond that carries them through the war.
song.analysis: Light-touch rework of the kept song. Structure frozen — all eleven original sections restored in order. Mostly verbatim; the grief-love lyric is anchored only where a generic line begs for it: the Rift replaces the thawing spring ("the ice is melting, the Rift is clearing"); "you" becomes Seraphina — "not like any light I fear," standing "so bright and white" in the endless night (the shared Void-touched strangeness). Chorus, Verse 2, second pre-chorus, bridges and outro kept verbatim. Suggested Suno direction: thawing ballad — soft piano rising through chilled strings, a sense of winter breaking into light.

section.reworked: The winter has been long and cold, The frozen land has lost its soul. But I still remember your warm embrace, The fire in your eyes, the smile on your face.

section.reworked: Now the spring is coming near, The ice is melting, the Rift is clearing, But you are not like any light I fear, You stand within this endless night, so bright and white.
